title: Native approval
responsibility: Lets a signed-in person review a desktop connection request and submit its displayed code.

inputs.name: NativeApproval.handoffId
inputs.description: Required identifier used to read the native request and approve it. Loading occurs on mount; prop changes alone do not reload.

outputs.name: NativeApproval
outputs.description: When framed, offers only guidance to open a standalone tab. Otherwise shows reading, expired, already-approved or pending request content. Pending form describes scope and account, then submits a trimmed uppercase code while blocking empty/concurrent requests. Success clears code and shows return-to-desktop guidance; errors are alerts. A failed initial request read falls back to pending after obtaining a fallback scope.
